diag.translation: abbr. 诊断, 判断（diagnostic）；特征（diagnosis）；对角线的（diagonal）；图示（diagram）；用图解法表示（diagram）

diagenesis.translation: [地质]成岩作用, 岩化作用 .

diageo.translation: 迪阿吉奥公司总部所在地：英国主要业务：饮料

diageotropic.definition: a. Relating to, or exhibiting, diageotropism.

diageotropism.definition:
n. The tendency of organs (as roots) of plants to
   assume a position oblique or transverse to a direction towards the
   center of the earth.

diaghilev.translation:
un. 迪亚吉列夫(Sergei,1872-1929,俄国芭蕾舞大师)
[网络] 基列夫；狄亚基列夫；戴亚基列夫

diaglyph.definition: n glyptic art consisting of a sunken or depressed engraving or carving on a stone or gem (as opposed to cameo)
diaglyph.translation: n. 凹雕, 阴雕, 凹雕玉石

diagnose.definition:
v. determine or distinguish the nature of a problem or an illness through a diagnostic analysis
v. subject to a medical analysis

diagnosed.definition:
v determine or distinguish the nature of a problem or an illness through a diagnostic analysis
v subject to a medical analysis

diagnoses.definition:
n identifying the nature or cause of some phenomenon

v subject to a medical analysis

diagnosing.definition:

v subject to a medical analysis

diagnosis.definition: n. identifying the nature or cause of some phenomenon

diagnostic.definition:
a. concerned with diagnosis; used for furthering diagnosis
s. characteristic or indicative of a disease
diagnostic.translation:
a. 诊断的, 有助于诊断的, 特征的
n. 诊断, 病的征候, 诊断法
[计] 诊断的

diagnostic program.translation:
[计] 诊断程序
[经] 诊断程序

diagnostic test.translation:
[计] 诊断检查; 诊断试验
[经] 诊断检验

diagnosticate.definition:
v. t. & i. To make a diagnosis of; to recognize by its
   symptoms, as a disease.

diagnostician.definition: n. a doctor who specializes in medical diagnosis
diagnostician.translation:
n. 诊断医生, 诊断专家
[医] 诊断医师

diagnosticians.definition:
plural of diagnostician
n. a doctor who specializes in medical diagnosis
diagnosticians.translation:
(diagnostician 的复数) n. 诊断医生, 诊断专家
[医] 诊断医师

diagnostics.definition: n the branch of medical science dealing with the classification of disease
diagnostics.translation:
n. 诊断学, 症候, 症状
[医] 诊断学

diagnostor.translation: [计] 诊断程序, 诊断器, 诊断电路

diagometer.definition:
n. A sort of electroscope, invented by Rousseau, in which
   the dry pile is employed to measure the amount of electricity
   transmitted by different bodies, or to determine their conducting
   power.

diagonal.definition:
n. (geometry) a straight line connecting any two vertices of a polygon that are not adjacent
n. a line or cut across a fabric that is not at right angles to a side of the fabric
n. an oblique line of squares of the same color on a checkerboard
n. (mathematics) a set of entries in a square matrix running diagonally either from the upper left to lower right entry or running from the upper right to lower left entry
diagonal.translation:
a. 对角线的, 斜的, 斜纹的
n. 对角线, 斜线, 斜列

diagonal expansion.translation: [经] 斜行扩展, 对角扩展

diagonalise.definition: v transform a matrix to a diagonal matrix

diagonalizable.definition: a. capable of being transformed into a diagonal matrix

diagonalization.definition: n. changing a square matrix to diagonal form (with all non-zero elements on the principal diagonal)

diagonalize.definition: v transform a matrix to a diagonal matrix
diagonalize.translation:
vi.循对角线方向移动,斜向移动
vt.使对角线化,与…斜向地成一行

diagonalizing.definition: v transform a matrix to a diagonal matrix
diagonalizing.translation: 重播(同一节目在不同时间或用不同频率播出)

diagonals.definition:
n. (geometry) a straight line connecting any two vertices of a polygon that are not adjacent
n. a line or cut across a fabric that is not at right angles to a side of the fabric
n. an oblique line of squares of the same color on a checkerboard
diagonals.translation: n. <数>对角线( diagonal的复数形式 ); 斜线

diagram.definition:
n. a drawing intended to explain how something works; a drawing showing the relation between the parts
v. make a schematic or technical drawing of that shows interactions among variables or how something is constructed

diagrammatic representation.translation:

[化] 图示法

diagrammatical.definition: s shown or represented by diagrams

diagrammatize.translation: vt. 作成图表, 图解

diagrammed.definition:
past participle of diagram
n. a drawing intended to explain how something works; a drawing showing the relation between the parts

diagrammed.translation: (diagram 的过去分词) n. 图表；图解

diagrams.definition:

diagraph.definition: n. A drawing instrument, combining a protractor and scale.
diagraph.translation:
n. 分度尺, 作图器, 原图放大绘图器
[医] 描界器
